subject: Fix use-after-free in tlsProcessPendingData() on CLIENT KILL (#4234)
reason: The fix is a use-after-free confined to tlsProcessPendingData() in src/tls.c, reachable only with multiple concurrent TLS client connections that have SSL-buffered pending data, one of which is freed synchronously (CLIENT KILL -> freeClient -> connTLSClose -> listDelNode) while another is being iterated. The fuzzer cannot establish TLS connections: tls-port is a managed/forbidden server option with no certificate provisioning, valkey.action.commands and the workloads connect over plain TCP (docs state replies come 'over a raw connection without TLS'), and valkey.action.tools starts non-TLS pri
